messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Traffic spike + elevated 5xx on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings originating from us-east-1 ingress pool. Trigger: error-rate > 3% over 5m. Incident ID: INC-20260315-42
ryan (oncall): I'm paged, looking. any immediate customer reports? :eyes:
vania (cs): saw three support tickets from enterprise tenants A/B/C for embeddings timeouts ~12:29Z, forwarding ticket ids.
amanda (sre): digging into gateway logs + ingress autoscaler. initial glance: sudden burst of long-context chat requests and heavy batched embedding jobs.
jess (infra): autoscale added nodes but we hit per-route qps throttles on proxy layer. route table shows chat:rate-limit=2000/s global, embeddings:rate-limit=500/s global, rerank:enabled.
nick (eng): reproducing locally with a replay of the sampled requests. embeddings payloads are large (multi-doc) and some clients sending 3x normal batch size.
ryan (oncall): mitigation options: 1) tighten per-key chat qps, 2) raise embeddings qps for healthy customers and throttle noisy ones, 3) disable rerank temporarily. propose we do 2+3 to relieve embedding pipeline.
oliver (product): prioritize not breaking chat for paid customers. if we throttle chat, restrict to non-paid/enumerable keys only.
amanda (sre): agreed. immediate plan: apply route-specific tweaks for hot paths, and apply a temporary feature-flag to disable rerank for non-essential flows. I'll own the changes and monitor.
metrics-bot: graph posted -> /graphs/INC-20260315-42: error-rate chat 5xx up to 6.1%, embeddings latency p95 from 220ms->1.8s.
ryan (oncall): oncall handoff note: I'll be online for 10 more mins then hand to amanda if needed.
amanda (sre): starting live mitigations now. running commands:
```
# reduce chat global per-key qps for non-paid tier
rproxyctl set-key-limit --tier=free --route=/v1/chat --qps=10
# raise embeddings regional limit for tagged enterprise clients
rproxyctl set-route-limit --route=/v1/embeddings --qps=1200 --tag=enterprise:true
# disable rerank for public tenants
featurectl toggle rerank --scope=non-enterprise --state=off
```
ryan (oncall): +1 to the above. Please add a short TTL to all changes (15m) so they auto-roll back unless we extend.
jess (infra): applied TTL=15m on all proxy changes. synching with control-plane.
metrics-bot: update -> embeddings p95 down to 420ms within 60s after changes, chat 5xx down to 1.2%.
vania (cs): notifying impacted customers: "We’re applying temporary routing changes to reduce errors. This may limit advanced rerank features for non-enterprise customers. Enterprise customers A/B/C are on elevated path; monitoring closely."
oliver (product): good. flag CS to offer extended logs or priority support for affected customers.
nick (eng): I'm going to throttle large-batch submissions at API gateway - add a soft size cap per-request to favor smaller batches while we stabilize. pushing config now:
```
apigwctl set-limit --route=/v1/embeddings --field=batch_size --max=64
```
jess (infra): gateway config applied. will take a minute to propagate.
amanda (sre): monitoring for errors/regressions. current action items: 1) keep rerank disabled for non-enterprise, 2) keep embeddings raised only for enterprise tags, 3) soft-limit large batches, 4) observe metrics for 10m.
metrics-bot: 3m update -> overall 5xx < 0.8%, embeddings throughput normalized for enterprise tags, non-enterprise embeddings retries increasing slightly.
ryan (oncall): handing over full incident to amanda. I'm stepping out. amanda, take over and coordinate postmortem. tagging you as incident lead. :white_check_mark:
amanda (sre): taking lead. will keep TTL extensions as needed. next steps: extend TTL to 60m if metrics stable at 10m mark, open incident page, and gather client request samples for root cause.
vania (cs): CS will collect customer impact details and list any feature regressions reported (rerank disabled). we have 2 customers asking for timeline, will escalate to account managers.
oliver (product): please capture when rerank was disabled and which tenant groups saw it. need to evaluate feature gating for future mitigation.
amanda (sre): note for postmortem: cause hypothesis = uncontrolled batching from a subset of clients combined with global rerank CPU spike that cascaded into proxy throttles. will capture with logs.
nick (eng): creating a quick rate-limiter rule to auto-scale per-key by historical baseline to avoid blanket throttles in future. PR issued.
amanda (sre): extending TTL to 60m now that we're stable for 12m.
jess (infra): confirmed TTL extended; config will auto-revert in 60m unless extended. please sign off when ready to close.
metrics-bot: final update -> steady state: 5xx at 0.4%, latency back to baseline.
amanda (sre): leaving a follow-up checklist: 1) postmortem draft, 2) improve per-key adaptive rate limits, 3) better detection for big-batch embedding patterns, 4) product decision on rerank fallback. assigning owners.
vania (cs): closing customer comms loop: told customers A/B/C we mitigated, will follow up with timeline & RCA.
amanda (sre): incident moved to mitigated state at 12:58Z. I will take on the write-up. thanks everyone. :heart:
ryan (oncall): back to normal ops, nice work team.
